citation.authors: Gaesser GA, Rodriguez J, Patrie JT, Whisner CM, Angadi SS
citation.title: Effects of Glycemic Index and Cereal Fiber on Postprandial Endothelial Function, Glycemia, and Insulinemia in Healthy Adults

population.description: Eleven healthy adults (5 men, 6 women), University of Virginia; mean ± SD age 42.4 ± 16.1 y, weight 70.5 ± 10.7 kg, BMI 23.5 ± 3.1 kg/m2, body fat 26.0% ± 8.9%. Enrolment excluded age <18 or >64, smoking, dieting, pregnancy, oral contraceptives, known cardiovascular or metabolic disease, and antihypertensive, lipid- or glucose-lowering drugs; glucose tolerance was not tested. Each subject ate all four breakfasts (randomized crossover).

protocols.name: hf_lgi
protocols.description: High-Fiber, Low-GI (HF-LGI) breakfast, crossover visit: high-fiber cereal (Kellogg's All-Bran Buds) 36 g, enriched white bread 20 g, margarine spread 19 g, eggs 44 g, nonfat milk 290 g, apple slices 175 g, apple juice 260 g. Table 1 gives total carbohydrate 108.3 g, total fiber 20.4 g, protein 20.0 g, fat 15.7 g. meals carbs_g is digestible carbohydrate = total carbohydrate - total fiber = 108.3 - 20.4 = 87.9 g (the paper states digestible carbohydrate was approximately 90 g per meal). Blood drawn before the meal (minute 0) and hourly for 4 h (60, 120, 180, 240 min), so duration_min = 240 + 1 = 241. Arrival 7-9 AM in a 12-h postabsorptive state (water only after ~7 PM), then 30 min supine rest and baseline FMD before the meal: the clock hour of the meal and the exact hours of fast at minute 0 are not stated (8.0 and 12 used). Meal details from Table 1: fibre_g 20.4 is the total fiber; fat_g_by_type is saturated 3.6, monounsaturated 5.2, polyunsaturated 5.4 g (trans fat 0.9 g, glycemic index 44, ~600 kcal and sodium not entered); fat_source is the added margarine spread. Sugars are not printed; protein comes from eggs, nonfat milk and cereal/bread with no split printed, so protein_source is not entered. form is mixed: the meal includes apple juice and nonfat milk.

meals.food: All-Bran Buds, white bread, margarine, eggs, nonfat milk, apple, apple juice
